device: piezo_stage, the piezo controller on COM4 through the vendor library
what_this_run_does: Opens COM4, reads, closes. It writes no position, does not change the controller's security level, and does not touch the waveform generator. Nothing moves.

sequence.note: opens the serial port; the vendor program must be closed, and the person said it is

sequence.call: FindCommands and GetCommand for every index
sequence.note: the controller's own list of commands at its current security level; library introspection, nothing is sent as a command
fixes the position unit: a 600 um axis reading 6.0e8 is picometres

sequence.rule: every command in the controller's own list whose name ends in '.get' AND contains one of: 'mode', 'analogue', 'analog', 'digital', 'identity', 'version', 'serial'
sequence.channels: each such command taking one parameter is read on channels 1, 2 and 3; one taking none is read once; any other is not sent and is recorded as skipped
sequence.note: the analogue and digital command enables settle whether the controller listens to the analogue line NIS can drive; the exact command names are read from the controller rather than guessed

refused_by_the_script: any command not ending in '.get', any '.set', 'lock', 'unlock', 'start', 'stop', 'waveform' or 'function' command, and any command not matched above. The link is opened read-only, so a position write or a security change is refused by the driver as well.
left_as: the controller at the security level it was found at, no position written, the port closed
